nodes.element: GET /api/cards — tabs list + a base tab's ordered card grid
nodes.pseudocode: ?tabs=1 → public __base worlds as tabs + open-ground count. ?tab=<slug|open-ground> → { base: Card|null, cards: Card[] } via one playerSpace query (slug,name,ownerId,owner,forkOfId,isPublic,updatedAt,_count, snapshot worldData.card/blurb/vision/__base only — DON'T ship whole snapshots), rootBaseOf over the id→forkOfId map, orderGrid, cardFromRow. Icons referenced by slug (the icons endpoint serves PNGs) — never inline base64 in the feed.

nodes.element: the art windows are ALIVE — each card's icon shader runs in WebGPU in the grid
nodes.pseudocode: ONE shared WebGPU device; per-card canvas contexts; each card compiles its composeIcon WGSL (engine visual_* convention) inside a standalone wrapper (fullscreen tri, time uniform, uni() stub if unreferenced-undefined); compile error or no WebGPU → silent fallback to baked PNG → hue placeholder. IntersectionObserver gates rendering to visible cards; shared 30fps rAF loop. Feed carries iconWgsl+hue per card (composeIcon like browse).
